plugins.name: workflow-toolkit
plugins.description: Get up to speed in any codebase, any size. Non-opinionated workflow plugin with session journaling, local task tracking, GitHub issue sync, knowledge base generation, and lifecycle hooks. All backed by SQLite, all local.

skills.name: contribution-check
skills.description: Pre-flight checklist for open source contributions. Validates code changes against project rules, PR size limits, commit format, linting, and type-checking. Does NOT push or create PRs — only reports issues.
headings: Count changed lines (excluding lockfiles, generated files, docs)

skills.name: create-agent
skills.description: Creates a new Claude Code custom subagent configuration. Guides you through designing agent scope, tools, permissions, hooks, and system prompts.
headings: Create a New Claude Code Subagent

skills.name: create-skill
skills.description: Creates a new Claude Code custom skill (slash command). Guides you through designing, writing, and placing the SKILL.md file with proper frontmatter, arguments, and best practices.
headings: Create a New Claude Code Skill

skills.name: db-viewer
skills.description: Open the journal SQLite database in a GUI viewer (DB Browser for SQLite, or similar).

skills.name: distill-concept
skills.description: Distills a codebase concept into a structured knowledge base entry. Analyzes patterns, conventions, and real examples from the code to create reference documentation. Use when you need to understand how something works in this project (e.g., React hooks, API routers, database models, testing patterns).

skills.name: help
skills.description: Show usage information for any workflow-toolkit skill. Use when the user asks how to use a specific skill, what a skill does, or needs guidance on workflow-toolkit features. Also triggers on "help", "how do I", "what does X do", or "usage" in the context of workflow-toolkit skills.

skills.name: issues-list
skills.description: List and filter tracked GitHub issues from the local SQLite database. Filter by state, label, priority, tracking status, or search by keyword.

skills.name: issues-sync
skills.description: Sync GitHub issues from the repo into the local SQLite database for tracking. Supports full CRUD — pull open/closed issues, detect changes, and prune stale entries. Read-only on GitHub (never posts).

skills.name: issues-triage
skills.description: Update the local tracking metadata for a GitHub issue. Set priority, tracking status, or add notes. Does not modify the issue on GitHub.
headings: note — append to existing notes with timestamp

skills.name: issues-view
skills.description: View detailed information about a specific GitHub issue. Shows the full body, comments, labels, and local tracking metadata. Can fetch fresh data from GitHub or read from local DB.

skills.name: journal-read
skills.description: Read and query journal entries. Shows recent activity, search by keyword, or filter by date. Can read from both SQLite and markdown entries.

skills.name: journal-write
skills.description: Write a journal entry documenting what was done in this session. Records what changed, why, and next steps. Saves to both SQLite and a timestamped markdown file.

skills.name: pr-prepare
skills.description: Prepares a pull request description. Generates the title, body, and checklist — then STOPS and presents everything for user review. Does NOT create the PR or push code without explicit user consent.
headings: Current branch and diff from main

skills.name: skill-and-agent-factory
skills.description: Creates skills, agents, or both together. A unified factory for building Claude Code extensions with proper configuration, best practices, and coordinated workflows.
headings: Both -> Create agent first, then skill referencing it.
skills.name_hint: 技能 · and · 智能体 · factory

skills.name: task-create
skills.description: Create a new task with a title and optional description, priority, tags, and linked GitHub issue. Creates a task folder and inserts into SQLite.

skills.name: task-done
skills.description: Mark a task as done. Records completion time. Shortcut for /task-update <id> status done.

skills.name: task-list
skills.description: List and filter local tasks from SQLite. Filter by status, priority, or search by keyword.

skills.name: task-start
skills.description: Mark a task as in-progress. Shortcut for /task-update <id> status in-progress.

skills.name: task-update
skills.description: Update a task's field (status, priority, tags, notes, description). Updates both SQLite and the task's TASK.md file.
headings: For status changes, also update started_at / completed_at
If status = 'in-progress', set started_at if null

skills.name: task-view
skills.description: View full details of a specific task by ID or slug, including its TASK.md contents.

skills.name: workflow-db-setup
skills.description: Initialize and verify the workflow-toolkit environment. Checks SQLite availability, creates the journal database, verifies directory structure, checks gh CLI auth, and reports readiness. Run this after installing the plugin or when troubleshooting.

headings: Why SQLite and Not Just Markdown?
Native installer (recommended — auto-updates, no Node.js required)
